title: Dante's Return/Quotes
summary:
"Did you miss me, Harrison?"
- Den Fears to Harrison Fears after the latter apologized to Den for joining the Spirals

"Who stands against my inevitable designs?"

- The Betrayer to Harrison Fears and Den Fears

"Traitors." (The Betrayer to Harrison and Den)

"You're one to talk." (Harrison Fears)

"Betrayer, it's because of you that my family has been hunted!" (Sophie Casterwill)

"You pretended to be my father, you made Dante sacrifice himself, and you tricked me into being a part of it!" (Lok Lambert)

"You're going down." (Den Fears)

- the team to the Betrayer before their final battle

"Didn't predict this, huh?"

- Lok Lambert to the Betrayer after destroying Demigorgan's mimics with Powerbonded Pendragon

"This Titan of Betrayal has gotta go, now!"

- Lok Lambert

"Did you really believe you could stop what I set in motion so many eons ago? Watch helplessly as I bring the Spiral Mark back to life."

- The Betrayer to the Huntik team

"I was just thinking... If the world ends tonight, I'll never go on another adventure with you again." (Sophie Casterwill)

"No way. I won't let that happen." (Lok Lambert)

"It doesn't matter how many stand before me."

- The Betrayer to Sandra Lambert and Lucas Casterwill

"You have troubled our families for long enough, mister."

- Sandra Lambert to the Betrayer

"No more audience participation."

- The Betrayer to the Huntik team before knocking them back with Shocklash

"You can't get rid of me that easily."
- Dante Vale to Zhalia Moon through Logosbook

"I cannot be stopped by something as fleeting as mortal men." (The Betrayer)

"Good thing I don't fit that description today." (Dante Vale)

"The Betrayer fears his own medicine."

- Nostradamus through his prophecies
